samples.prompt: One day, a little girl named Lily
samples.text:
One day, a little girl named Lily went for a walk in the woods. She saw many trees and animals she met was very happy. She loved to walk and play with her friends.
As Lily walked, she met a friendly squirrel. The squirrel had a big smile and a small nose. Lily and the squirrel played together every day. They ran and laughed and had lots of fun.
As the sun began to set, Lily said goodbye to her friends. She said, "Bye bye, squirrel! See you soon!" The squirrel went to sleep, but then turned around and went back home. Lily told her mom about the pretty forest and the squirrel who met her new friend. Her mom was proud of her for being kind and listening to her mom.
